He climbed the iron stairs to the radio room and began transmitting, because hope, like the sea, does not respect the calendar.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市尚在沉睡的边缘。路灯将橙黄色的光晕投在空旷的柏油路面上，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，轮胎碾过积水发出细微的声响。早点铺的老板已经开始揉面，蒸笼里升起第一缕白雾，混着面粉与葱花的香气弥漫在巷口。环卫工人推着小车沿街而行，扫帚划过落叶的沙沙声是这座城市最早的心跳。天际线处，黑暗正在褪去，一抹灰蓝色从高楼的缝隙中渗透进来，预告着新的一天即将苏醒。这是城市最诚实的时刻，没有喧嚣，只有呼吸。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself with a smaller version of the same problem — like looking up a word in the dictionary and finding it defined using another word you also need to look up.\n• Every recursive function needs a \"base case\" — a simple version of the problem it can answer right away without calling itself again, so it doesn't keep going forever.\n• Imagine you're in a line of people and want to know how many are behind you: you ask the person behind you, they ask the person behind them, and so on until the last person says \"zero\" — then each answer comes back up the line, adding one each time."}
